PARTIALLY MISDESCRIBED. Line 1646 confirmed: this.$t('label.kds_status_conflict'). Verified via node: message.kds_status_conflict EXISTS (fr.json:1464), label.kds_status_conflict is UNDEFINED -> vue-i18n renders raw key string. Line 2280 legacy correctly uses message namespace. BUT the finding's 409 trigger is FALSE: onV2ChangeStatus catch block (1640-1647) does `if (err.response.status===409){ this._debouncedRefresh(); return; }` BEFORE reaching line 1646 -> on 409 the banner is intentionally SILENT, never hits 1646. Line 1646 only fires on NON-409 errors (500/network). For those errors, 'kds_status_conflict' (="modified elsewhere") is the WRONG message regardless of namespace. So the title/why_it_matters/reproduction (all '409 -> raw label') will NOT reproduce. The underlying raw-label/undefined-namespace bug at 1646 is real but rare (only non-409 errors) and the surfaced text is semantically wrong anyway. Downgraded P2->P3: real raw-label exposure but misframed trigger + low frequency + wrong-message-regardless. Fix: use a generic error i18n key on the non-409 branch, not message.kds_status_conflict.

Currently dormant design-philosophy note, no exploitable defect -> DROP (would resurface only if/when chef-confirmed allergens are seeded, at which point it is a design choice to revisit).
